info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Cedar Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Cedar Battery Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information about Cedar batteries in the catalog. This API allows users to submit specifications, features, and other related data to enhance product listings. Typical consumers include product managers, catalog administrators, and inventory systems aiming to ensure accurate representation of products. By streamlining the detail entry process, businesses can maintain competitive inventories and provide comprehensive product information to customers.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to add detailed information about a new Cedar Battery, including specifications, performance metrics, and other relevant attributes. Ensure all required fields are filled out to successfully create a new entry.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the details required to create a new Cedar Battery entry. Please ensure that all required fields are populated appropriately.

200.description: The request was successfully processed, and the response contains the requested battery details.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the cedar battery.

supplier.description: Information about the supplier of the cedar batteries.
